title_zh: RailWeave AI辅助空间织法比选记录
method_boundary_zh: 本记录说明AI辅助设计搜索如何在参与者设定的约束和规则下提出、比较并淘汰空间织法。它不证明方案最优，不代替规划、建筑、景观、交通、市政、消防、文保、生态、无障碍或工程专业判断，也不构成政府审定、场地授权、采购或实施决定。
method_boundary_en: This record explains how AI-assisted design search proposed, compared, and screened spatial-weave options under participant-defined constraints and rules. It does not prove optimality; replace planning, architecture, landscape, transport, utility, fire, heritage, ecology, accessibility, or engineering judgement; or constitute government determination, site authorisation, procurement, or implementation approval.

input_constraints.value_zh: 公开底图按L4使用，空间建议按L5表达；不得把临时几何升级为正式边界。
input_constraints.value_en: Use the open basemap at L4 and express spatial proposals at L5; never promote provisional geometry into an official boundary.

input_constraints.value_zh: 总体设计约11.4平方公里、三处重点区域合计约368.4公顷，形成一轴、三条横向联动廊和三处差异化结点。
input_constraints.value_en: Organise an approximately 11.4 km² overall-design extent and three key areas totalling approximately 368.4 ha as one axis, three lateral links, and three differentiated nodes.

input_constraints.value_zh: 纵向公共空间和六个概念性横向核查段均须形成可继续深化的工作接口。
input_constraints.value_en: The longitudinal public realm and all six conceptual lateral audit segments must remain available as interfaces for further study.

input_constraints.value_zh: L4具名京张公园多边形与L5临时范围的约413米最短距离作为待核问题保留，不作一致性包装。
input_constraints.value_en: Retain the approximately 413 m minimum separation between the L4 named Jing-Zhang park polygon and the L5 provisional extent as an unresolved issue rather than presenting false alignment.

input_constraints.value_zh: 固定导视、纸质、电话、人工和连续通行构成不依赖模型、账号或网络的基础经线。
input_constraints.value_en: Fixed signs, paper, telephone, staffed channels, and continuous passage form a baseline warp that does not depend on a model, account, or network.

input_constraints.value_zh: 任何AI线程均不得因空间方案被选中而自动准入；织体成熟门和线程准入门必须分别签收。
input_constraints.value_en: No AI thread is automatically admitted because a spatial option is selected; the Fabric Maturity Gate and Thread Admission Gate require separate sign-off.

screening_rules.rule_zh: 须同时回应纵向公共空间、三条横向联动廊和三处重点区域。
screening_rules.rule_en: Must address the longitudinal public realm, three lateral links, and all three key areas.

screening_rules.rule_zh: 公共空间、普通服务和横向可达接口不得被孤立结点或单一技术设施切断。
screening_rules.rule_en: Public space, ordinary service, and lateral-access interfaces may not be severed by isolated nodes or a single technical facility.

screening_rules.rule_zh: AI原点、众智园和大钟寺须分别承担需求组织、独立验证和首用转化，不作同质化园区复制。
screening_rules.rule_en: AI Origin, Zhongzhiyuan, and Dazhongsi must respectively organise demand, independent validation, and first-use conversion rather than duplicate one generic park.

screening_rules.rule_zh: 关闭AI后，公众仍可通过非数字和人工渠道完成基本到达、咨询、办理和申诉。
screening_rules.rule_en: After AI is switched off, the public must still be able to complete basic arrival, enquiry, service, and appeal through non-digital and staffed channels.

screening_rules.title_en: AI thread can be blocked and unwoven
screening_rules.rule_zh: 单项AI服务必须具有独立准入、人工终决、停止触发、恢复责任和退出回执。
screening_rules.rule_en: Each AI service requires independent admission, human final decision, stop triggers, restoration accountability, and an exit receipt.

screening_rules.rule_zh: 未核现状、权利、专业条件和资料冲突必须在图文与结构化记录中保持可见。
screening_rules.rule_en: Unverified baseline, rights, professional conditions, and source conflicts must remain visible in graphic, narrative, and structured records.

candidate_options.design_logic_zh: 集中加强京张纵向公共空间，以统一导视和慢行连续为主要动作。
candidate_options.design_logic_en: Concentrate on the longitudinal Jing-Zhang public realm through unified wayfinding and walking continuity.
candidate_options.reason_zh: 可形成纵向形象，但横向联动、三结点差异化和AI线程治理不足，不能完整回应任务书。
candidate_options.reason_en: It can form a longitudinal identity, but lacks lateral linkage, differentiated node roles, and AI-thread governance, so it does not fully respond to the brief.

candidate_options.design_logic_zh: 将资源集中于三处重点区域，以各自的展示、服务和试验设施形成高强度结点。
candidate_options.design_logic_en: Concentrate resources in the three key areas, forming intensive nodes through separate display, service, and testing facilities.
candidate_options.reason_zh: 结点职能较清晰，但易形成三个孤岛，普通服务经线和横向公共联系不能连续。
candidate_options.reason_en: Node roles are clearer, but the scheme risks three islands and does not sustain the ordinary-service warp or lateral public connections.

candidate_options.design_logic_zh: 以一条不断线的公共服务经线组织三条横向联动廊和三处差异化结点；十二类AI服务作为可独立准入、阻断和解编的线程接入。
candidate_options.design_logic_en: Use an unbroken public-service warp to organise three lateral links and three differentiated nodes; admit the twelve AI services as threads that can be independently admitted, blocked, and unwoven.
candidate_options.reason_zh: 在投稿阶段同时覆盖空间连续性、差异化结点、普通服务基线、双门治理和证据边界，作为L5概念深化底稿。
candidate_options.reason_en: At submission stage, it covers spatial continuity, differentiated nodes, the ordinary-service baseline, dual-gate governance, and evidence boundaries, so it is retained as the L5 concept-development basis.

spatial_components_zh: 一条京张公共服务经线
清河、小月河与高校、转河三条横向联动廊
AI原点、众智园、大钟寺三处差异化结点
六个横向连续性核查段
十二类可退出AI服务线程
spatial_components_en: Three lateral links towards Qinghe, Xiaoyue River and universities, and Zhuanhe
Three differentiated nodes at AI Origin, Zhongzhiyuan, and Dazhongsi
selected_option_output.selection_limit_zh: 入选仅表示在参与者设定规则下进入L5概念深化，不代表相对其他可能方案最优，也不产生现场准入。
selected_option_output.selection_limit_en: Selection means only that the option proceeds to L5 concept development under participant-defined rules. It does not establish superiority over all other possible options or confer field admission.

five_state_method.decision_zh: 先保证普通公共空间和普通服务连续可用。
five_state_method.decision_en: First keep the ordinary public realm and ordinary services continuously usable.

five_state_method.decision_zh: 仅在双门分别通过后，限范围、限时段、限责任接入一条AI线程。
five_state_method.decision_en: Only after both gates pass separately, admit one AI thread within limited space, time, and accountability.

five_state_method.decision_zh: 任一权利、安全、数据、人工或公共价值条件失效，立即失败关闭。
five_state_method.decision_en: Fail closed when any rights, safety, data, human, or public-value condition fails.

five_state_method.decision_zh: 撤销访问、处置数据、撤离设备、恢复场地和替代服务，并形成回执。
five_state_method.decision_en: Revoke access, dispose of data, remove equipment, restore the site and alternative service, and issue a receipt.

five_state_method.decision_zh: 保留经确认可维护的固定导视、纸质工具、人工渠道、失败档案和公共方法。
five_state_method.decision_en: Retain confirmed and maintainable fixed signs, paper tools, staffed channels, failure records, and civic methods.
